siteName: McMurdo Dry Valleys (Wright Valley), Antarctica (Copernicus GLO-30 Polar Supplement)
nativeResolutionLabel: 1 arc-second (~30 m Copernicus GLO-30; NASADEM out-of-bounds)

provenance.datasetName: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (High-Latitude Supplement for NASADEM >60°N / <56°S cutoff)
provenance.provider: ESA / Copernicus Open Data Registry (NASADEM latitude limit supplement)
provenance.processingPerformed: Extracted 3840 m × 3840 m window via HTTP Range read from Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_S78_00_E161_00_DEM (NASADEM out-of-bounds south of 56°S) and bilinearly resampled onto 30.0 m EPSG:32757 (UTM Zone 57S) grid. NASADEM coverage check: OUT_OF_BOUNDS (NASADEM_HGT V001 ends at 56°S due to SRTM shuttle inclination; supplemented by real 30 m Copernicus GLO-30 tile S78E161).
provenance.resamplingMethod: Bilinear interpolation onto 30.0 m metric grid
provenance.limitations: OUT_OF_BOUNDS (NASADEM_HGT V001 ends at 56°S due to SRTM shuttle inclination; supplemented by real 30 m Copernicus GLO-30 tile S78E161)
